gender_rule: Binary native labels (FairFace, UTKFace) normalised to male/female; LFW gender only from a documented external label file, otherwise unknown and excluded from gender comparisons.
age_rule: FairFace native bands and UTKFace ages bucketed into the same categories.yaml bands; LFW has no age labels.
skin_rule: ITA, L*, hue and skin groups use one pixel pipeline (MEA) for every dataset
visual_rule: visual measures use one pipeline (VIS) for every dataset
